name: student-performance-tracking-monorepo
description: Fullstack Student Performance Tracking System - Vanness Plus Skill Test by Saharath Wiangkaew

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
